title: English Practice Quiz 0897
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A training needs analysis identifies ___.
options: skills or knowledge employees need to develop
questions.explanation: skills or knowledge employees need to develop is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A learning objective describes ___.
options: what a participant should be able to do after training
questions.explanation: what a participant should be able to do after training is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

options: observe how a task is performed
questions.explanation: observe how a task is performed is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

options: reinforce and update existing knowledge or skills

questions.question: Constructive feedback should be ___.
